name: Bump OpenInference Instrumentation Version

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC

jobs:
  bump-instrumentation-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests

      - name: Get latest openinference-instrumentation version
        id: get_instrumentation_version
        run: |
          import requests
          import json
          
          response = requests.get('https://pypi.org/pypi/openinference-instrumentation/json')
          version = response.json()['info']['version']
          print(f"Latest openinference-instrumentation version: {version}")
          print(f"::set-output name=version::{version}")

      - name: Update instrumentation version in pyproject.toml files
        run: |
          find . -name "pyproject.toml" -type f -exec sed -i "s/openinference-instrumentation >=[0-9.]*\.[0-9.]*\.[0-9.]*/openinference-instrumentation >=${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}/" {} \;

      - name: Create Pull Request for instrumentation version bump
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation version to ${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}"
          title: "Bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}"
          body: "Automated PR to bump openinference-instrumentation version to ${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}"
          branch: "bump-instrumentation-${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}"

  bump-semantic-conventions-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests

      - name: Get latest openinference-semantic-conventions version
        id: get_semantic_conventions_version
        run: |
          import requests
          import json
          
          response = requests.get('https://pypi.org/pypi/openinference-semantic-conventions/json')
          version = response.json()['info']['version']
          print(f"Latest openinference-semantic-conventions version: {version}")
          print(f"::set-output name=version::{version}")

      - name: Update semantic conventions version in pyproject.toml files
        run: |
          find . -name "pyproject.toml" -type f -exec sed -i "s/openinference-semantic-conventions >=[0-9.]*\.[0-9.]*\.[0-9.]*/openinference-semantic-conventions >=${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }}/" {} \;

      - name: Add lower-bound pin for google-genai instrumentor
        run: |
          sed -i "s/openinference-semantic-conventions >=0.1.28/openinference-semantic-conventions >=0.1.28/" ./instrumentation/google-genai/pyproject.toml

      - name: Create Pull Request for semantic conventions version bump
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump openinference-semantic-conventions version to ${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }}"
          title: "Bump openinference-semantic-conventions to ${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }}"
          body: "Automated PR to bump openinference-semantic-conventions version to ${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }}"
          branch: "bump-semantic-conventions-${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }}"
